description: An agent requests authorization to perform a specific action under a parent plan. Returns 'ok' with a signed receipt (proceed with the action), 'checkpoint_required' (human must re-approve this specific action), or 'denied' (agent or action not authorized under the plan).

action.description: Specific action the agent wants to perform (e.g. 'build:docker')

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent requesting delegation

name: pl_delegate
